<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the molecule shows two equivalent aromatic doublets (4 H total), indicating a para‑disubstituted benzene ring. The aliphatic region displays two triplets (2 H each, J ≈ 7 Hz), consistent with a –CH₂‑CH₂‑ fragment where each CH₂ is adjacent only to another CH₂ and to non‑protonated groups. Combining these features suggests a para‑substituted phenylpropionic acid, e.g., 4‑chlorophenylpropionic acid. Its SMILES representation is “O=C(O)CCc1ccc(Cl)cc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(O)CCc1ccc(Cl)cc1</final_answer>
